top_stories.title: Ledger Investigates Reseller Theft/Warns Buyers After Wallet Losses
points: Ledger is investigating reports of stolen customer funds, traced to devices bought through an unauthorized/compromised reseller (CryptoBilis)
Onchain investigator Specter traced roughly $87 million in suspected losses across Ethereum, Tron, and Bitcoin, though Ledger has not confirmed the amount or cause

CryptoBilis paused all sales and shipments; buyers from the last 90 days told not to set up devices, and existing users advised to move funds to new wallets with fresh seed phrases (recovery codes that restore wallet access)
Incident fits a broader pattern of hardware wallet security issues this year, including Coldcard's $130M exploit in August and a Trezor shipping partner/email provider breach

unique_angles.point: Frames the incident as a broader warning about counterfeit or compromised hardware wallets entering the market via unauthorized resellers, advising customers to buy only from Ledger or authorized retailers

items.title: Bitcoin Price Movement and Market Outlook
points: Bitcoin trading at $82,730 (up 0.2% in 24 hours) after dipping below $81,000 Thursday amid an oil-driven market sell-off
Prediction markets show 63% odds BTC stays between $82K-$84K by Sunday 4 p.m. UTC, with 21% downside risk below $82K and just 1% chance above $86K
September CPI data due Wednesday is the next major catalyst; support levels to watch range from $83,000 down to $72,000

items.title: Starknet's Layer-1 Independence Plan
points: Ethereum Layer-2 (a blockchain that processes transactions faster/cheaper than the main Ethereum network) Starknet's token jumped 20% after it announced plans to become an independent Layer-1 blockchain
Starknet claims this move could make it the first fully quantum-resistant network by 2027, protecting against future quantum computer attacks

items.title: New York AG Penalizes Former Celsius CEO
points: New York Attorney General secured up to $35 million from former Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky plus an industry ban
Penalties increase if Mashinsky forfeits tokens early or does not complete his sentence

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Outflows
points: Bitcoin ETFs saw $729 million in net outflows, signaling reduced institutional or retail demand for crypto exposure via traditional funds
Outflows reflect broader investor pullback, possibly tied to profit-taking

items.title: Thailand ETF Regulations
points: Thailand approved new rules governing cryptocurrency-based ETFs (exchange-traded funds, investment products that trade on stock exchanges)
Rules are expected to create clearer compliance frameworks and investor protections in the region's digital asset market

sections.title: Ledger Reseller Warning
points: Ledger warned buyers about purchasing from unauthorized resellers after multiple customers reported losing access to their wallets
The warning suggests potential risks including counterfeit hardware wallets or compromised devices entering the market through unofficial channels
Customers are advised to purchase directly from Ledger or authorized retailers to ensure device authenticity and security
